🎬 The Angry Birds Movie 3 (2027)

The Angry Birds Movie 3 brings the colorful world of Angry Birds back to the big screen for another animated adventure. Following the success of the first two movies, the third installment continues the franchise’s signature mix of hilarious characters, explosive action, and chaotic comedy. Familiar favorites like Red, Chuck, and Bomb are set to return as the birds prepare for another round of unexpected trouble, ridiculous situations, and exciting adventures. With its playful humor, energetic animation, and beloved video game characters, the upcoming film aims to deliver another entertaining experience for audiences of all ages.

🎭 Genre: Animation • Comedy • Adventure • Family

📅 Release Date: December 23, 2026 (updated from the previously announced 2027 date).

🎥 Director: John Rice

🏆 Recognition: The third installment of the popular Angry Birds movie franchise features returning voices Jason Sudeikis, Josh Gad, Rachel Bloom, and Danny McBride, alongside newcomers including Emma Myers, Keke Palmer, and MrBeast.

📺 Where to Watch: Exclusively in movie theaters beginning December 23, 2026. Streaming availability has not been announced.
